Name: Unofficial RSV - Kiarra seasonal outfit
Author: UndyneWolf
Description:
I'm a big fan of the Ridgeside village mod and whenever I play stardew I use mods, and it was always a little sad to see only the ridgeside characters not having their clothes changed in seasons or events, so I decided to create it for some npcs, and first I used one one of the ones I like most about Kiarra.
this mod is unofficial and credit and thanks goes to the creator of ridgeside and Alissa and Ysabelle's seasonal clothing mods

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url]
